findings.initialRisk: The local ARRAY/STRUCT/MAP parser recursed without consuming sqlparser's private recursion counter, so deeply nested input could grow the Rust call stack.
findings.resolution: The complex-type helper now accepts a local depth argument, rejects depth above 128 with ParserError, and has a 129-level rejection regression. The limit is local to the new complex-type path; no global parser behavior was changed.

findings.initialRisk: Using debug_assert! to consume CAST would disappear in release/WASM builds, leaving the parser cursor on CAST.
findings.resolution: The implementation uses parser.expect_keyword_is(Keyword::CAST), which consumes CAST in every build profile.

findings.initialRisk: Spark accepts STRUCT<a STRING>; treating it as malformed would reject valid original SQL.
findings.resolution: The parser accepts both named-field forms, STRUCT<a: STRING> and STRUCT<a STRING>, with a direct unit regression.

findings.initialRisk: Two LATERAL VIEW clauses can syntactically supply the same output alias. sqlparser stores both clauses without uniqueness validation, while StatementContext currently inserts the alias into a HashMap and silently overwrites the earlier UDTF producer with the later one.
findings.minimalCase: SELECT r.goods FROM t LATERAL VIEW explode(a) e1 AS r LATERAL VIEW explode(b) e2 AS r
findings.resolution: StatementContext now removes the first binding and records the alias in a scope-local ambiguity set when a duplicate is registered. Qualified expansion checks real relations first and then the ambiguity set, so neither UDTF producer is selected. The visitor emits an UNRESOLVED_REFERENCE error, and the regression asserts that r.goods has neither a nor b as a physical root.

evidence: FlowscopeHiveDialect::is_identifier_start adds only ch == '_' and delegates all other characters to upstream HiveDialect.
No SQL text rewrite or cross-dialect Generic fallback is present.
Integration regression checks CTE/table/column aliases, physical value roots, WindowControl roles, and explicit INSERT target mapping.
parse_prefix intercepts only CAST and delegates CAST expression parsing to the normal Hive parser.
ARRAY/STRUCT/MAP are emitted using existing sqlparser DataType AST variants; no full-statement Generic fallback or SQL text replacement is present.
Malformed bracket, MAP arity, and missing field-type inputs are rejected; nested >> handling is covered.
Integration regression checks CAST value lineage, WindowControl roles, and schema-backed INSERT target mapping.

perPositionContract.derivedOutput: For an output column materialized as Derived, require that exact output fs_uid to have one direct target_map edge to the Physical column declared by insertTarget position.
perPositionContract.physicalOutput: For an output column materialized as target Physical, do not invent or require an output Derived fs_uid. Require the parser target Physical four-part identity to equal the insertTarget position; then validate each incoming edge whose from node is a valid Derived column has a direct target_map from that source fs_uid to that Physical target. Multiple such source maps for one position are valid.
perPositionContract.nonColumnRelationDependency: An incoming CTE/table node is a relation-level dependency and is not a column-value producer. It must be validated through CTE/table relations, not target_map, and must never be converted into a Derived fs_uid.

insertPositionValidationContractReview.guardHealthExample: In 557564, cte_03308bea4466e370 (guard_health, type=cte) has relation-level data_flow to the target table and derivation CAST(NULL...) edges to target Physical output columns. It is not a column node and the loader deliberately excludes it from line-690 target-map generation; treating those 18 edges as missing target maps is a false positive.
insertPositionValidationContractReview.mappingBasisCaveat: The physical-output branch at loader line 690 does not set mapping_basis. _CY_DERIVED_TO_PHYSICAL therefore persists its direct, position-backed maps as legacy_name by coalesce default. legacy_name count cannot be used to reject these edges or infer a missing position map. If proof provenance itself must be enforced by relationship property, set mapping_basis=insert_position in that branch and rerun a fresh isolated graph.
